Dear Tailspin Ltd,

We have processed a refund of 175 CHF‑4C9H for the invoicing error where your invoice was issued in USD instead of the contracted currency CHF‑4C9H. The original invoice has been corrected to CHF‑4C9H. Future invoices will reflect the correct currency.

Thank you for your patience.

Best regards,
Customer Support Team
